'''Wolf''' can refer to the following:

* [[Wolf|Wolves]] - a sentient race of creatures.
* [[The Wolf King]] - a figure in the [[Karaethon Cycle]].
* The [[wolf dream]] - another name for ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]''.
* The [[Wolf-Head Banner]] - the banner of [[Perrin Aybara]].
* [[Perrin's Wolf Dreams]] - Perrin's prophetic visions in the wolf dream.
* ''[[The Dragon Reborn/Chapter 9|Wolf Dreams]]'' - the ninth chapter of ''[[The Dragon Reborn]]''.
* "the Wolf" or "the Little Wolf" when not present - the nickname of [[Domani]] [[Lord]] [[Rodel Ituralde]].
